method.detection: Peak search within 8 px of the prediction, then 2D Gaussian + planar background fit to the coma photocentre; position converted with each frame's own WCS.
method.alignment: Each sequence reprojected (bilinear) onto one north-up TAN grid at 6.15"/px; field stars confirm alignment.
method.flags: Flag names/bits/descriptions read from each FITS FLAGS header (MSKN/MSKM/MSKD). Hardware/processing flags rejected; OUTLIER kept for the comet because the pipeline's multi-frame outlier detection fires on moving objects.
method.wavelength: Per-frame wavelength at the comet from the WCS-WAVE lookup table. SPHEREx's linear variable filter means every exposure is a different wavelength; frames are not combined into a spectrum.

verdict: Confirmed known-object match: the measured positions and times agree with the MOST prediction, the measured motion matches the predicted rate and direction, field stars are stationary, and the earlier position is vacated. This recovers a comet that was already known. It is not a discovery.
